snippet.title: Fruity Fauna - indie puzzle match-3 game trailer
snippet.description:
Match fruits to feed cute animals, learn their stories & decorate their world!

DOWNLOAD Fruity Fauna: Match & Learn
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Wyli.FruityFauna
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fruity-fauna/id6476689945

🧩 Match. Learn. Decorate
Welcome to Fruity Fauna, the cozy match-3 puzzle game where your every move helps adorable animals thrive — and teaches you something new along the way!

🍓 HOW TO PLAY:
- Tap groups of 3+ matching fruits to merge them into a flower
- Chain your matches, trigger combos, and fill your animal friend's fruit cravings!
- Tap flowers to spread new fruits across the board
- No more matches? The level ends — so plan ahead to keep the combos flowing!

🐾 MEET THE FAUNA:
Every level you complete feeds an animal and unlocks a quirky, science-based fact — told in their own voice.
From curious toucans to lazy bearcats, build your bestiary of interesting animals and uncover the natural world one level at a time.

🪴 EXPRESS YOURSELF:
Earn gold as you play and spend it to decorate your backgrounds. Mix and match environments and items to suit your mood. The more you decorate, the more you level up and unlock new scenes!

👥 OPTIONAL SOCIAL FEATURES:
- Add friends, send gifts, and peek at their progress and decorations
- No internet? No problem — Fruity Fauna is fully offline-playable
- Optional ads only — watch if you want valuable rewards!

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT:
- Simple to start, but deeply strategic
- Unique tap-to-merge, tap-to-spread mechanics
- Fun, science-based animal facts told by the animals themselves
- Relaxing visuals, juicy animations, and sweet sound design
- Play anywhere, anytime — no forced ads, no pressure

If you love Royal Match, Gardenscapes, or Candy Crush but want something a little more meaningful, creative, and refreshing... Fruity Fauna is made for you
